generatorSets.fuelChangePermitTrigger: A change in the fuel may require a new or amended permit.
generatorSets.control_technologies: Turbocharged engines, charge air coolers, good operating practices and appropriate maintenance per manufacturer recommendations
generatorSets.allowedOperatingModes: Emergency operation during sudden and reasonably unforeseeable events that disrupt or disconnect the primary power source beyond the owner/operator’s control (e.g., electrical grid failure; on-site disaster or equipment failure; public service emergencies such as flood, fire, natural disaster, or severe weather conditions); and operation for periodic maintenance, testing, and operational training.
generatorSets.observationFrequency: not less than once each month in which the unit is operated
generatorSets.operatingHoursPerUnitRollingWindow: Consecutive 12-month rolling period, calculated monthly; compliance demonstrated each month by adding the most recently completed calendar month to the totals for the preceding 11 months.
